integrity.proof: Green-Kubo generator identity plus strict one-variable upper envelope and cubic monotonicity

scientific_limitations: Finite-state Markov switching; independent Gaussian angular diffusion; no stop-phase angular drift; no translational thermal diffusion.
The enhanced optimal diffusivity is a supremum approached with diverging rates, not an attained finite-rate optimum.
The exact diffusivity is known in broader form; the assessed scientific contribution is the sharp global two-rate optimization and nonattainment theorem.
Independent publication-priority and external scientific validation are not performed.
title: Sharp two-rate enhancement threshold for intermittent chiral swimmers
